upload_metadata.description:
Pattern Lab breaks down what is actually working right now and why.

This episode uses an artifact-first test around: A scorecard teardown of thumbnail patterns that earn clicks without misleading the viewer.

The artifact is a thumbnail teardown table. The goal is to show the criteria, the rejected ideas, and the pattern that survives scrutiny.

No hype. No recycled takes. Just patterns, criteria, and proof.
